app.already_running.message.source: Another KiwiDesk instance is already managing your windows, so this one will quit.
app.already_running.message.translation: 另一个 KiwiDesk 实例已在管理您的窗口，因此此实例将退出。

app_bar.alignment.label.help.source: Where the item group sits along the bar while it fits. Start and End follow the edge (a left bar's Start is its top); once items overflow and scroll, all three behave the same.
app_bar.alignment.label.help.translation: 项目在栏中的排列位置。

app_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.source: Boxed draws a box per item, not a shared plate, so there is nothing to size.
app_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.translation: 框状会在每个项目周围绘制方框，而非共享底板，因此无需缩放。

app_bar.color.gap_only.source: The Gap indicator hides the active item instead of marking it, so these colors aren't drawn.

app_bar.content.vertical_only.source: Left and right bars always show icons only.
app_bar.content.vertical_only.translation: 左侧 and right bars always show icons only.

app_bar.edge.label.help.source: Which screen edge the bar occupies. The bar reserves this edge in every layout that shows it.
app_bar.edge.label.help.translation: App Bar 依附的屏幕边缘。

app_bar.global_style.caption.source: The App Bar appears in the layouts that show one — Monocle and Scrolling. These settings are shared; a layout can override any of them below.
app_bar.global_style.caption.translation: 每个显示器一个栏，适用于所有布局。所有设置均为全局。

app_bar.group_adjacent.help.source: Merges neighbouring windows of the same app into a single item, marked with a count badge, instead of showing one item each.
app_bar.group_adjacent.help.translation: Merges neighbouring windows of the same app into a single item, marked with a count badge, instead of showing one item each.（ZH）

app_bar.icon_source.help.source: How app icons are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol from KiwiDesk's built-in icon set, colored by the bar's item colors — Item, Active item, and Hover item below — so those colors also decide how the glyphs look. Apps without a symbol keep their app icon.
app_bar.icon_source.help.translation: How app icons are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol from KiwiDesk's built-in icon set, colored by the bar's item colors — Item, Active item, and Hover item below — so those colors also decide how the glyphs look. 应用 without a symbol keep their app icon.

app_bar.icon_source.name_only.source: Icons are hidden while Content is Name.
app_bar.icon_source.name_only.translation: Icons are hidden while Content is Name.（ZH）

app_bar.layout.overrides.caption.source: Dimmed rows inherit the global value — tick a box to override just that field for this layout.
app_bar.layout.overrides.caption.translation: Dimmed rows inherit the global value — tick a box to override just that field for this layout.（ZH）

app_bar.layout.overrides.disabled.source: Turn on Show app bar to edit this layout's overrides. They are kept either way.
app_bar.layout.overrides.disabled.translation: Turn on Show app bar to edit this layout's overrides. They are kept either way.（ZH）

app_bar.liquid_glass.help.source: Lays a translucent glass material over the boxes or the plate. The Fill color tints it, though the tint reads subtle on current macOS.
app_bar.liquid_glass.help.translation: Lays a translucent glass material over the boxes or the plate. The Fill color tints it, though the tint reads subtle on current macOS.（ZH）

app_bar.no_layout.help.source: No layout shows an App Bar — turn one on below.
app_bar.no_layout.help.translation: No layout shows an App Bar — turn one on below.（ZH）

app_bar.preview.ax.translation: App Bar 预览：位置 %1$@，样式 %2$@。

app_rules.float.help.source:
Floating takes this app's matching windows out of tiling: each keeps its last position and size and appears on every space, instead of living in one space's grid.

This is per-app floating — not the **Floating** layout mode, which floats every window in a space.
app_rules.float.help.translation:
该应用程序的窗口将始终浮动在平铺布局上方。

这是按应用设置的浮动，并非 **Floating** 布局模式。

app_rules.override.caption.source: Space and float rules made here apply to this profile only. Dimmed facets are inherited from the app-wide base rules and stay in sync with them; changing a facet overrides it for this profile, and deleting a row removes inherited rules here. To edit the base rules themselves, switch back to the currently loaded profile in the header's picker.
app_rules.override.caption.translation: Space and float rules made here apply to this profile only. Dimmed facets are inherited from the app-wide base rules and stay in sync with them; changing a facet overrides it for this profile, and deleting a row removes inherited rules here. To edit the base rules themselves, switch back to the currently loaded profile in the header's picker.（ZH）

app_rules.override.overrides.source: This profile overrides base app rules.
app_rules.override.overrides.translation: This profile overrides base app rules.（ZH）

app_rules.remove_all.help.source: Remove all rules for this app
app_rules.remove_all.help.translation: 移除 all rules for this app

app_rules.remove_override.help.source: Remove this profile's effective space and float rules for this app
app_rules.remove_override.help.translation: 移除 this profile's effective space and float rules for this app

app_rules.section.caption.source: Pin an app's windows to a space, keep them floating, or both. Deleting a row removes all of the app's rules.
app_rules.section.caption.translation: Pin an app's windows to a space, keep them floating, or both. Deleting a row removes all of the app's rules.（ZH）

app_rules.titled.caption.source: Windows whose title contains a pattern stay floating.
app_rules.titled.caption.translation: Windows whose title contains a pattern stay floating.（ZH）

bars.same_edge.source: Both bars share the %1$@ edge — Space Bar sits at the screen edge, App Bar sits next to the windows.
bars.same_edge.translation: Both bars share the %1$@ edge — Space Bar sits at the screen edge, App Bar sits next to the windows.（ZH）

bars.switch.caption.source: KiwiDesk draws two bars — choose which one to configure.
bars.switch.caption.translation: KiwiDesk draws two bars — choose which one to configure.（ZH）

behavior.animations.scrolling_xref.source: Scrolling-layout focus shifts have their own toggle and speed in
behavior.animations.scrolling_xref.translation: Scrolling-layout focus shifts have their own toggle and speed in（ZH）

behavior.animations.space_change.caption.source: Windows slide out of the space you're leaving and into the one you're switching to.
behavior.animations.space_change.caption.translation: Windows slide out of the space you're leaving and into the one you're switching to.（ZH）

behavior.mouse.resize_action.help.source:
**Resize adjacent windows** — Dragging a window's edge resizes it and reflows its neighbours in the layout.
**Snap back to slot** — The window resizes freely while you drag, then snaps back to its tiled size when you release.
behavior.mouse.resize_action.help.translation:
**Resize adjacent windows** — Dragging a window's edge resizes it and reflows its neighbours in the layout.
**Snap back to slot** — The window resizes freely while you drag, then snaps back to its tiled size when you release.（ZH）

behavior.quit.caption.source: Before KiwiDesk stops, it arranges managed windows on each display so their title bars remain reachable.
behavior.quit.caption.translation: Before KiwiDesk stops, it arranges managed windows on each display so their title bars remain reachable.（ZH）

behavior.quit.summary.source: 2×2 up to %1$d windows · 3×3 up to %2$d · 4×4 above %2$d
behavior.quit.summary.translation: 2×2 up to %1$d windows · 3×3 up to %2$d · 4×4 above %2$d（ZH）

behavior.quit.target_depth.help.source: The grid adds a row and column when cells would exceed this target. It stays between 2×2 and 4×4; after 4×4, additional windows keep cascading in its cells.
behavior.quit.target_depth.help.translation: The grid adds a row and column when cells would exceed this target. It stays between 2×2 and 4×4; after 4×4, additional windows keep cascading in its cells.（ZH）

border.caption.source: Outlines the focused window so it stands out in a gapped layout.
border.caption.translation: 自定义环绕聚焦窗口的边框。

border.controls.disabled.source: Turn on Show focus border to edit these settings.
border.controls.disabled.translation: Turn on Show focus border to edit these settings.（ZH）

border.fit_gaps.action_hint.source: Updates the draft gap values. Save is still required.
border.fit_gaps.action_hint.translation: Updates the draft gap values. 保存 is still required.

border.fit_gaps.help.source: Calculates global outer and inner gaps from the border width. Inner gaps allow for both borders when borders on unfocused windows are shown.
border.fit_gaps.help.translation: Calculates global outer and inner gaps from the border width. Inner gaps allow for both borders when borders on unfocused windows are shown.（ZH）

border.fit_gaps.preview.source: Will set Outer to %1$d pt and Inner to %2$d pt.
border.fit_gaps.preview.translation: Will set Outer to %1$d pt and Inner to %2$d pt.（ZH）

border.fit_gaps.updated.source: Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to apply and persist.
border.fit_gaps.updated.translation: Draft updated — 保存 (⌘S) to apply and persist.

border.fit_gaps.updated_inactive.source: Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to persist; it applies when this profile is loaded.
border.fit_gaps.updated_inactive.translation: Draft updated — 保存 (⌘S) to persist; it applies when this profile is loaded.

border.fit_gaps.updated_new.source: Draft updated — Save as New Profile… to apply and persist.
border.fit_gaps.updated_new.translation: Draft updated — 保存 as New Profile… to apply and persist.

border.fit_gaps.updated_paused.source: Draft updated — gaps persist once Accessibility is on and you save the profile.
border.fit_gaps.updated_paused.translation: Draft updated — gaps persist once Accessibility is on and you save the profile.（ZH）

border.glow.a11y.source: Soft glow around the focus border
border.glow.a11y.translation: Soft glow around the focus border（ZH）

color_field.swatch.help_auto.translation: 自动 — follows light and dark

config_issues.delete_confirm.body.source: This removes the profile file. It can't be undone.
config_issues.delete_confirm.body.translation: This removes the profile file. It can't be undone.（ZH）

config_issues.empty.body.source: The last configuration load completed cleanly.
config_issues.empty.body.translation: The last configuration load completed cleanly.（ZH）

config_issues.header.source: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded.
config_issues.header.translation: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded.（ZH）

config_issues.profile_unreadable.source: Couldn't be loaded — it was saved by a different version or edited by hand.
config_issues.profile_unreadable.translation: Couldn't be loaded — it was saved by a different version or edited by hand.（ZH）

config_issues.reload.help.source: Re-runs the config load; fixed files clear their issues.
config_issues.reload.help.translation: Re-runs the config load; fixed files clear their issues.（ZH）

custom_lua_banner.text.source: Your init.lua also has custom Lua. It doesn’t conflict with the visual editor, and the app never modifies init.lua.
custom_lua_banner.text.translation: Your init.lua also has custom Lua. It doesn’t conflict with the visual editor, and the app never modifies init.lua.（ZH）

discard.apply_preset.message.source: Applying a preset replaces the edits you haven't saved.
discard.apply_preset.message.translation: Applying a preset replaces the edits you haven't saved.（ZH）

discard.delete_profile.message.source: Deleting reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.
discard.delete_profile.message.translation: Deleting reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.（ZH）

discard.load_profile.message.source: Loading a profile replaces the edits you haven't saved.
discard.load_profile.message.translation: Loading a profile replaces the edits you haven't saved.（ZH）

discard.lua_editor.message.source: The raw editor saves init.lua as text, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.
discard.lua_editor.message.translation: The raw editor saves init.lua as text, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.（ZH）

discard.rename_profile.message.source: Renaming reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.
discard.rename_profile.message.translation: Renaming reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.（ZH）

discard.switch_profile.message.source: Switching profiles drops the edits you haven't saved.
discard.switch_profile.message.translation: Switching profiles drops the edits you haven't saved.（ZH）

discard.visual_editor.message.source: Leaving the raw editor reloads init.lua from disk, dropping the Lua you haven't saved.
discard.visual_editor.message.translation: Leaving the raw editor reloads init.lua from disk, dropping the Lua you haven't saved.（ZH）

drag.border.off_help.source: Turn on Border to edit its color, width, and alignment.
drag.border.off_help.translation: Turn on Border to edit its color, width, and alignment.（ZH）

drag.caption.source: Drag a window onto another to swap their positions in the layout.
drag.caption.translation: 使用鼠标拖动和调整窗口大小的行为。

drag.disabled.help.source: Turn on Enabled to edit this visual.
drag.disabled.help.translation: Turn on Enabled to edit this visual.（ZH）

drag.drop_zone.caption.source: Marks the position your window will snap into when dropped.
drag.drop_zone.caption.translation: Marks the position your window will snap into when dropped.（ZH）

drag.fill.off_help.source: Turn on Fill to edit its color.
drag.fill.off_help.translation: Turn on Fill to edit its color.（ZH）

drag.ghost.caption.source: Marks the position your window is dragged from.
drag.ghost.caption.translation: Marks the position your window is dragged from.（ZH）

floating.color.space_bar_only.source: The floating mark is drawn only in the Space Bar, which is off.
floating.color.space_bar_only.translation: The floating mark is drawn only in the Space Bar, which is off.（ZH）

footer.revert.restores_layout.source: Revert also restores the profile layout (%1$@).
footer.revert.restores_layout.translation: Revert also restores the profile layout (%1$@).（ZH）

footer.save.adopts_layout.source: Save also adopts the session layout (%1$@).
footer.save.adopts_layout.translation: 保存 also adopts the session layout (%1$@).

footer.save.globals_only.source: Layout and monitors stay paused; Save covers everything else.
footer.save.globals_only.translation: Layout and monitors stay paused; 保存 covers everything else.

footer.save_as_new.message.source: The new profile carries the current tiling and the connected monitor set.
footer.save_as_new.message.translation: The new profile carries the current tiling and the connected monitor set.（ZH）

footer.save_copy_as.message.source: Duplicates “%1$@” with your pending edits — monitor sets and shortcut overrides included. The copy becomes the edit target; the running layout is not changed.
footer.save_copy_as.message.translation: Duplicates “%1$@” with your pending edits — monitor sets and shortcut overrides included. The copy becomes the edit target; the running layout is not changed.（ZH）

gaps.mixed.help.source: Edges differ — edit them individually below.
gaps.mixed.help.translation: Edges differ — edit them individually below.（ZH）

gaps.outer_meaning.source: between windows and the screen edge
gaps.outer_meaning.translation: between windows and the screen edge（ZH）

general.advanced.edit_lua.caption.source: Opens the integrated Lua editor for custom scripting beyond the visual controls.
general.advanced.edit_lua.caption.translation: 打开s the integrated Lua editor for custom scripting beyond the visual controls.

help.button.hint.source: Shows an explanation of this setting.
help.button.hint.translation: Shows an explanation of this setting.（ZH）

icon_picker.search.placeholder.source: Search icons (or an SF Symbol name)
icon_picker.search.placeholder.translation: 搜索 icons (or an SF Symbol name)

key_recorder.help_press.source: A shortcut is one key plus any of ⌃ Control, ⌥ Option, ⇧ Shift, and ⌘ Command — it locks in the moment you press the key. For more shortcut layers, add Modes.
key_recorder.help_press.translation: A shortcut is one key plus any of ⌃ Control, ⌥ Option, ⇧ Shift, and ⌘ Command — it locks in the moment you press the key. For more shortcut layers, add 模式s.

key_recorder.live_applied.source: Active now — Save to keep it
key_recorder.live_applied.translation: Active now — 保存 to keep it

key_recorder.live_apply_failed.source: The shortcut change was recorded but couldn't be applied live. Save or Revert to retry.
key_recorder.live_apply_failed.translation: The shortcut change was recorded but couldn't be applied live. 保存 or Revert to retry.

key_recorder.live_denied.source: Recorded — the system didn't grant it
key_recorder.live_denied.translation: Recorded — the system didn't grant it（ZH）

key_recorder.live_profile_shadowed.source: Recorded — the active profile overrides it
key_recorder.live_profile_shadowed.translation: Recorded — the active profile overrides it（ZH）

key_recorder.revert_failed.source: Revert couldn't restore the running shortcuts. Fix the configuration, then try again.
key_recorder.revert_failed.translation: Revert couldn't restore the running shortcuts. Fix the configuration, then try again.（ZH）

key_recorder.revert_used_snapshot.source: Saved shortcuts couldn't be read, so Revert restored the previous running shortcuts.
key_recorder.revert_used_snapshot.translation: 保存d shortcuts couldn't be read, so Revert restored the previous running shortcuts.

keybinding.conflict.system.source: Shortcut for "%1$@" is conflicting with the macOS shortcut "%2$@".
keybinding.conflict.system.translation: “%1$@”的快捷键与 macOS 系统快捷键“%2$@”冲突。

keybinding.conflict.unrecognized.source: Shortcut for "%1$@" isn't a recognized shortcut.
keybinding.conflict.unrecognized.translation: Shortcut for "%1$@" isn't a recognized shortcut.（ZH）

keybinding.move_to_space_follow.translation: 移动到空间 %1$@ 并跟随

keybinding.toggle_display_sticky.help.source: Keeps this window visible on every space of the monitor it lives on. Moving it to a space on another monitor re-homes it there. Turn a sticky window fully global with Toggle sticky.
keybinding.toggle_display_sticky.help.translation: Keeps this window visible on every space of the monitor it lives on. Moving it to a space on another monitor re-homes it there. Turn a sticky window fully global with Toggle sticky.（ZH）

keybinding.toggle_sticky.help.source: Keeps this window visible on every space. A tiled sticky window can be rearranged only on its home space — elsewhere, its position follows automatically. A floating sticky window isn't affected — it moves freely everywhere.
keybinding.toggle_sticky.help.translation: Keeps this window visible on every space. A tiled sticky window can be rearranged only on its home space — elsewhere, its position follows automatically. A floating sticky window isn't affected — it moves freely everywhere.（ZH）

layout.schematic.bsp.ax.source: BSP preview: width ratio %1$d percent, height ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.
layout.schematic.bsp.ax.translation: BSP preview: width ratio %1$d percent, height ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.（ZH）

layout.schematic.bsp.caption_alternating.source: Splits alternate horizontal then vertical; the + tile is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.bsp.caption_alternating.translation: Splits alternate horizontal then vertical; the + tile is where the next window opens.（ZH）

layout.schematic.bsp.caption_longest.source: Each split cuts the longer side; the + tile is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.bsp.caption_longest.translation: Each split cuts the longer side; the + tile is where the next window opens.（ZH）

layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid.source: A fixed %1$d × %2$d grid; each window shrinks to a cell, extras stack in the last.
layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid.translation: A fixed %1$d × %2$d grid; each window shrinks to a cell, extras stack in the last.（ZH）

layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid_auto.source: A fixed grid sized to your screen (about 3 × 3); each window shrinks to a cell.
layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid_auto.translation: A fixed grid sized to your screen (about 3 × 3); each window shrinks to a cell.（ZH）

layout.schematic.grid.order_columns.source: New windows fill across a row, then wrap down.
layout.schematic.grid.order_columns.translation: New windows fill across a row, then wrap down.（ZH）

layout.schematic.grid.order_rows.source: New windows fill down a column, then wrap across.
layout.schematic.grid.order_rows.translation: New windows fill down a column, then wrap across.（ZH）

layout.schematic.monocle.ax.source: Monocle preview: one window fills the screen; focus cycles through the others.
layout.schematic.monocle.ax.translation: Monocle preview: one window fills the screen; focus cycles through the others.（ZH）

layout.schematic.monocle.caption_h.source: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles left/right.
layout.schematic.monocle.caption_h.translation: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles left/right.（ZH）

layout.schematic.monocle.caption_v.source: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles up/down.
layout.schematic.monocle.caption_v.translation: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles up/down.（ZH）

layout.schematic.scrolling.ax.source: Scrolling preview: a row of windows framed by the screen, continuing off both edges; the anchor window holds focus.
layout.schematic.scrolling.ax.translation: Scrolling preview: a row of windows framed by the screen, continuing off both edges; the anchor window holds focus.（ZH）

layout.schematic.scrolling.caption.source: Focus rests at the anchor; the row scrolls off past it. The + is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.scrolling.caption.translation: 焦点 rests at the anchor; the row scrolls off past it. The + is where the next window opens.

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_ax.source: Follow preview: two frames — the focus steps one slot over and the viewport pans just enough to reveal it, leaving the previous window visible.
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_ax.translation: 跟随 preview: two frames — the focus steps one slot over and the viewport pans just enough to reveal it, leaving the previous window visible.

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_b.source: When focus steps to the next window
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_b.translation: When focus steps to the next window（ZH）

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_captio.source: The viewport holds still and pans the minimum to reveal the focus, keeping the side you came from in view.
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_captio.translation: The viewport holds still and pans the minimum to reveal the focus, keeping the side you came from in view.（ZH）

layout.schematic.stack.ax.source: Stack preview: %1$d master windows, master ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.
layout.schematic.stack.ax.translation: Stack preview: %1$d master windows, master ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.（ZH）

layout.schematic.stack.caption_all.source: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the whole zone piles so only the top edges show.
layout.schematic.stack.caption_all.translation: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the whole zone piles so only the top edges show.（ZH）

layout.schematic.stack.caption_overflow.source: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the surplus piles up.
layout.schematic.stack.caption_overflow.translation: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the surplus piles up.（ZH）

layout.schematic.track.ax.source: Track preview: tracks along one axis, the far one piling overflow; the plus is the next window.
layout.schematic.track.ax.translation: Track preview: tracks along one axis, the far one piling overflow; the plus is the next window.（ZH）

layout.schematic.track.caption_focused.source: New windows join the focused track; the far track piles the overflow.
layout.schematic.track.caption_focused.translation: New windows join the focused track; the far track piles the overflow.（ZH）

layout.schematic.track.caption_own.source: New windows open their own track; the far track piles the overflow.
layout.schematic.track.caption_own.translation: New windows open their own track; the far track piles the overflow.（ZH）

layout.track.header_caption.source: A more advanced layout: several windows can share one track, with a track limit and per-track resize.
layout.track.header_caption.translation: A more advanced layout: several windows can share one track, with a track limit and per-track resize.（ZH）

layout_defaults.min_window_size_caption.source: Windows never tile smaller than this. It also sets the auto-size grid's cell size.
layout_defaults.min_window_size_caption.translation: Windows never tile smaller than this. It also sets the auto-size grid's cell size.（ZH）

layout_params.master_orientation.help.source: How the master zone lines up its windows when the master count is more than one: stacked top to bottom, or side by side.
layout_params.master_orientation.help.translation: How the master zone lines up its windows when the master count is more than one: stacked top to bottom, or side by side.（ZH）

layout_params.overflow.stack.help.source:
**Cascade overflow** — Keeps as many windows fully tiled as fit, then cascades only the extra ones at the bottom.
**Cascade all** — Cascades the whole stack, showing a sliver of every window.
layout_params.overflow.stack.help.translation:
**Cascade overflow** — Keeps as many windows fully tiled as fit, then cascades only the extra ones at the bottom.
**Cascade all** — Cascades the whole stack, showing a sliver of every window.（ZH）

layout_params.overflow.track.help.source:
How the far-edge **overflow track** — which collects the tracks that don't fit side by side — packs its windows.
**Cascade all** (the default) — piles every window from the top.
**Cascade overflow** — tiles what fits, piles the rest.
An ordinary track that holds more windows than fit always overflows this second way; only the far-edge track is configurable.
layout_params.overflow.track.help.translation:
How the far-edge **overflow track** — which collects the tracks that don't fit side by side — packs its windows.
**Cascade all** (the default) — piles every window from the top.
**Cascade overflow** — tiles what fits, piles the rest.
An ordinary track that holds more windows than fit always overflows this second way; only the far-edge track is configurable.（ZH）

layout_params.split_ratio_h.help.source: How much of a side-by-side split's width goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every left/right split.
layout_params.split_ratio_h.help.translation: How much of a side-by-side split's width goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every left/right split.（ZH）

layout_params.split_ratio_v.help.source: How much of a stacked split's height goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every top/bottom split.
layout_params.split_ratio_v.help.translation: How much of a stacked split's height goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every top/bottom split.（ZH）

layout_params.split_strategy.help.source:
**Longest side** — Cuts whichever side of the region is longer, keeping new windows close to square.
**Alternating** — Alternates left/right and top/bottom cuts as the layout gets deeper, regardless of shape.
layout_params.split_strategy.help.translation:
**Longest side** — Cuts whichever side of the region is longer, keeping new windows close to square.
**Alternating** — Alternates left/right and top/bottom cuts as the layout gets deeper, regardless of shape.（ZH）

layout_params.stack_position.help.source: Which side of the screen the stack zone takes; the master zone gets the other side. The stack lines up to fit its strip: a left or right stack runs top to bottom, a top or bottom stack side by side.
layout_params.stack_position.help.translation: Which side of the screen the stack zone takes; the master zone gets the other side. The stack lines up to fit its strip: a left or right stack runs top to bottom, a top or bottom stack side by side.（ZH）

layout_params.wrap_focus.help.source: When on, moving focus past the last window wraps around to the first, and past the first back to the last, instead of stopping at the end.
layout_params.wrap_focus.help.translation: When on, moving focus past the last window wraps around to the first, and past the first back to the last, instead of stopping at the end.（ZH）

lua_editor.adopt.message.source: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup.
lua_editor.adopt.message.translation: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup.（ZH）

lua_editor.adopt.message_dirty.source: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup — but Adopt reads that file from disk, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.
lua_editor.adopt.message_dirty.translation: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup — but Adopt reads that file from disk, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.（ZH）

lua_editor.adopt.title.source: Adopt this config into the visual editor?
lua_editor.adopt.title.translation: Adopt this config into the visual editor?（ZH）

lua_editor.adopt_help.body.source: Your init.lua isn't deleted: it's kept as a commented-out backup in the new file. Gaps, layouts, rules, and keybindings are imported; a shortcut that can't be read back stays in the backup — re-add it in the Shortcuts section.
lua_editor.adopt_help.body.translation: Your init.lua isn't deleted: it's kept as a commented-out backup in the new file. Gaps, layouts, rules, and keybindings are imported; a shortcut that can't be read back stays in the backup — re-add it in the Shortcuts section.（ZH）

lua_editor.foreign_code.source: This init.lua contains hand-written Lua, so the visual editor is disabled to avoid overwriting it.
lua_editor.foreign_code.translation: This init.lua contains hand-written Lua, so the visual editor is disabled to avoid overwriting it.（ZH）

menu.accessibility_paused.tooltip.source: Click to grant Accessibility permission and resume tiling.
menu.accessibility_paused.tooltip.translation: Click to grant Accessibility permission and resume tiling.（ZH）

menu.layout.save.translation: 保存 Current Layout to Profile

menu.status.config_error.tooltip.source: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded — open Config Issues for details.
menu.status.config_error.tooltip.translation: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded — open Config Issues for details.（ZH）

menu.status.warning.tooltip.source: KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission. Window management is paused.
menu.status.warning.tooltip.translation: KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission. Window management is paused.（ZH）

monitor_chip.hint.main.source: Follows the main display — drag to pin, ⓧ for automatic
monitor_chip.hint.main.translation: 跟随s the main display — drag to pin, ⓧ for automatic

monitor_chip.hint.pinned.source: Pinned to this monitor — drag to move, ⓧ for automatic
monitor_chip.hint.pinned.translation: Pinned to this monitor — drag to move, ⓧ for automatic（ZH）

monitors.advanced.caption.source: Profiles reattach automatically when a known monitor setup is reconnected.
monitors.advanced.caption.translation: Profiles reattach automatically when a known monitor setup is reconnected.（ZH）

monitors.cards.caption.source: Drag a space between cards to pin it to a monitor or have it follow the main display. Dimmed spaces are placed automatically. Right-click a space for the same moves.
monitors.cards.caption.translation: Drag a space between cards to pin it to a monitor or have it follow the main display. Dimmed spaces are placed automatically. 右侧-click a space for the same moves.

monitors.not_connected.caption.source: This profile's monitors aren't attached right now, so its space placement can't be edited here. Connect its monitor setup to arrange spaces — the other sections still edit this profile.
monitors.not_connected.caption.translation: This profile's monitors aren't attached right now, so its space placement can't be edited here. Connect its monitor setup to arrange spaces — the other sections still edit this profile.（ZH）

monocle.app_bar_xref_state.source: The monocle app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in
monocle.app_bar_xref_state.translation: The monocle app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in（ZH）

native_spaces.empty.source: No native macOS Desktops detected. Add desktops in Mission Control to bind profiles.
native_spaces.empty.translation: No native macOS Desktops detected. 添加 desktops in Mission Control to bind profiles.

native_spaces.intro.source: Each Desktop is a native macOS Space from Mission Control. Pick a profile to load it automatically when that Desktop activates.
native_spaces.intro.translation: Each Desktop is a native macOS Space from Mission Control. Pick a profile to load it automatically when that Desktop activates.（ZH）

native_spaces.separate_warning.source: Separate display Spaces are on. KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays, so Desktop bindings may be ambiguous.
native_spaces.separate_warning.translation: Separate display Spaces are on. KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays, so Desktop bindings may be ambiguous.（ZH）

notification.permission_lost.body.source: Accessibility permission was revoked. Re-enable it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
notification.permission_lost.body.translation: Accessibility permission was revoked. Re-enable it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.（ZH）

onboarding.discovery.popover.source: KiwiDesk lives here. Click anytime for layouts and settings.
onboarding.discovery.popover.translation: KiwiDesk lives here. Click anytime for layouts and settings.（ZH）

onboarding.grant.body.source:
1. Click “Open System Settings” below.
2. Find KiwiDesk in the list and turn it on.
3. Come back here — we detect it automatically.
onboarding.grant.body.translation:
1. Click “打开 System Settings” below.
2. Find KiwiDesk in the list and turn it on.
3. Come back here — we detect it automatically.

onboarding.ready.body.source: KiwiDesk is already arranging your windows with sensible defaults. Open Settings and apply a preset for your setup — then fine-tune anything from there. You can always get back here from the menu bar.
onboarding.ready.body.translation: KiwiDesk is already arranging your windows with sensible defaults. 打开 Settings and apply a preset for your setup — then fine-tune anything from there. You can always get back here from the menu bar.

onboarding.spaces.body.source:
KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays. For predictable Desktop-to-profile bindings, turn off “Displays have separate Spaces.”

Basic tiling still works if you keep it on. Changing this setting requires logging out and back in.
onboarding.spaces.body.translation:
KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays. For predictable Desktop-to-profile bindings, turn off “Displays have separate Spaces.”

Basic tiling still works if you keep it on. Changing this setting requires logging out and back in.（ZH）

onboarding.welcome.body.source:
KiwiDesk arranges your windows automatically. To move and resize windows of other apps, macOS requires you to grant Accessibility permission.

KiwiDesk never reads your keystrokes and does not require disabling System Integrity Protection.
onboarding.welcome.body.translation:
KiwiDesk 会自动排列您的窗口。为了移动和调整其他应用程序的窗口大小，macOS 需要您授予“辅助功能”权限。

KiwiDesk 绝不会读取您的按键输入，也不需要禁用系统完整性保护 (SIP)。

palettes.caption.source: Apply a bundled or saved set of colors to the App Bar, Space Bar, borders, and drag visuals — a one-time paint, not a live link.
palettes.caption.translation: 将协调的配色方案应用到整个界面。

palettes.reserved.source: That name is a built-in palette — choose another.
palettes.reserved.translation: That name is a built-in palette — choose another.（ZH）

placement.new_window.help.source: Where a new window lands relative to the others: First or Last in the layout's order, or right before or after whichever window is focused at the moment it opens.
placement.new_window.help.translation: Where a new window lands relative to the others: First or Last in the layout's order, or right before or after whichever window is focused at the moment it opens.（ZH）

presets.caption.source: Built-in layouts per screen count. Apply loads one and saves it as a real, editable profile — only available when the connected screen count matches.
presets.caption.translation: 保存与恢复您喜爱的窗口排列。

presets.coder_and_monitor.summary.source: Editor and terminals on the main display; dashboards and logs on the second.
presets.coder_and_monitor.summary.translation: 编辑or and terminals on the main display; dashboards and logs on the second.

presets.command_center.summary.source: Workspace and docs center, communication left, logs and monitoring right.
presets.command_center.summary.translation: Workspace and docs center, communication left, logs and monitoring right.（ZH）

presets.developer.summary.source: IDE stack, scrolling docs, and a fullscreen preview space.
presets.developer.summary.translation: IDE stack, scrolling docs, and a fullscreen preview space.（ZH）

presets.dual_developer.summary.source: Code and docs on the main display; mail, chat, and media on the second.
presets.dual_developer.summary.translation: Code and docs on the main display; mail, chat, and media on the second.（ZH）

presets.editing_stored.source: Applying a preset switches your live layout, which editing a saved profile never does. Switch to Live to apply one.
presets.editing_stored.translation: Applying a preset switches your live layout, which editing a saved profile never does. Switch to Live to apply one.（ZH）

presets.focus_stack.summary.source: Two stacked task spaces and a deep-work monocle space.
presets.focus_stack.summary.translation: Two stacked task spaces and a deep-work monocle space.（ZH）

presets.minimalist.summary.source: Spacious gaps, a scrolling reading space, and single-focus work.
presets.minimalist.summary.translation: Spacious gaps, a scrolling reading space, and single-focus work.（ZH）

presets.start_here.source: Start here — apply a preset for your setup, then adjust anything from any tab.
presets.start_here.translation: Start here — apply a preset for your setup, then adjust anything from any tab.（ZH）

presets.visual_creative.summary.source: Frontend IDE and previews center, design canvas left, inspectors right.
presets.visual_creative.summary.translation: Frontend IDE and previews center, design canvas left, inspectors right.（ZH）

profile_header.menu.help.source: Pick a saved profile to edit — editing it won't switch your layout.
profile_header.menu.help.translation: Pick a saved profile to edit — editing it won't switch your layout.（ZH）

profile_header.status.built_in.source: Built-in layout — save as a profile to make it yours.
profile_header.status.built_in.translation: Built-in layout — save as a profile to make it yours.（ZH）

profile_header.status.editing_loaded.source: Editing %1$@'s saved overrides — saving re-applies %1$@ with your changes.
profile_header.status.editing_loaded.translation: 编辑ing %1$@'s saved overrides — saving re-applies %1$@ with your changes.

profile_header.status.editing_stored.source: Editing a saved profile — changes won't switch your layout.
profile_header.status.editing_stored.translation: 编辑ing a saved profile — changes won't switch your layout.

profile_header.status.no_match.source: No profile matches this monitor setup.
profile_header.status.no_match.translation: No profile matches this monitor setup.（ZH）

profile_header.status.unsaved_monitor.source: Unsaved monitor changes — update the profile to keep them.
profile_header.status.unsaved_monitor.translation: Unsaved monitor changes — update the profile to keep them.（ZH）

profiles.broken.cant_load.source: Can't load — saved by another version or edited by hand.
profiles.broken.cant_load.translation: Can't load — saved by another version or edited by hand.（ZH）

profiles.duplicate_default.help.source: Several profiles of this count are marked default; the alphabetically first wins.
profiles.duplicate_default.help.translation: Several profiles of this count are marked default; the alphabetically first wins.（ZH）

profiles.native_spaces.live_only.source: Desktop bindings are global — switch to Live to change them.
profiles.native_spaces.live_only.translation: Desktop bindings are global — switch to Live to change them.（ZH）

profiles.other_monitors.help.source: Saved for other monitors — loads with unsaved-changes state.
profiles.other_monitors.help.translation: 保存d for other monitors — loads with unsaved-changes state.

profiles.overlap_warning.source: This monitor set is also covered by %1$@ — exact-match ties load the alphabetically first.
profiles.overlap_warning.translation: This monitor set is also covered by %1$@ — exact-match ties load the alphabetically first.（ZH）

profiles.save_blocked_paused.source: Window management is paused because Accessibility access is off, so no displays are detected. Grant access first — a profile saved now would capture no monitors and never resolve.
profiles.save_blocked_paused.translation: Window management is paused because Accessibility access is off, so no displays are detected. Grant access first — a profile saved now would capture no monitors and never resolve.（ZH）

profiles.saved.empty.source: No profiles saved yet — the built-in Standard resolves until you save one.
profiles.saved.empty.translation: No profiles saved yet — the built-in Standard resolves until you save one.（ZH）

profiles.update_hint.source: "%1$@" is for %2$d screen(s); %3$d connected. Save as new instead.
profiles.update_hint.translation: "%1$@" is for %2$d screen(s); %3$d connected. 保存 as new instead.

scroll_grid.animate_focus_shifts.help.source: Moves windows smoothly when focus changes in a Scrolling space. Turn this off to move the layout immediately. Scroll speed sets how long the movement takes and has no effect while animation is off.
scroll_grid.animate_focus_shifts.help.translation: Moves windows smoothly when focus changes in a Scrolling space. Turn this off to move the layout immediately. Scroll speed sets how long the movement takes and has no effect while animation is off.（ZH）

scroll_grid.app_bar_xref_state.source: The scrolling app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in
scroll_grid.app_bar_xref_state.translation: The scrolling app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in（ZH）

scroll_grid.auto_size.gates.source: Auto-size grid is on for this space, so the screen decides the columns and rows.
scroll_grid.auto_size.gates.translation: Auto-size grid is on for this space, so the screen decides the columns and rows.（ZH）

scroll_grid.auto_size_caption.source: Fits as many columns and rows as the screen allows, using the minimum window size above.
scroll_grid.auto_size_caption.translation: Fits as many columns and rows as the screen allows, using the minimum window size above.（ZH）

scroll_grid.fill_empty_space.rigid_only.source: A rigid grid keeps every cell, so there is no empty space to fill.
scroll_grid.fill_empty_space.rigid_only.translation: A rigid grid keeps every cell, so there is no empty space to fill.（ZH）

settings.permission_paused.source: Window management is paused — KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission.
settings.permission_paused.translation: Window management is paused — KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission.（ZH）

shortcuts.advanced.caption.source: Bind any Lua to a hotkey. This is the power-user escape hatch — the groups above cover the built-in actions.
shortcuts.advanced.caption.translation: Bind any Lua to a hotkey. This is the power-user escape hatch — the groups above cover the built-in actions.（ZH）

shortcuts.app_behavior.help.source:
**Open or Focus** brings the app's existing window to the current space, or launches it if the app isn't running.

**Open New** always launches a fresh instance, even when the app is already open.
shortcuts.app_behavior.help.translation:
**打开 or Focus** brings the app's existing window to the current space, or launches it if the app isn't running.

**打开 New** always launches a fresh instance, even when the app is already open.

shortcuts.base_mode_protected.source: Base modes can't be removed here
shortcuts.base_mode_protected.translation: Base modes can't be removed here（ZH）

shortcuts.import.help.source: Reads the shortcuts active in init.lua and adds them here, matching each combo. Known actions sort into the groups below; anything else lands in Advanced. Review, then Save.
shortcuts.import.help.translation: Reads the shortcuts active in init.lua and adds them here, matching each combo. Known actions sort into the groups below; anything else lands in Advanced. Review, then 保存.

shortcuts.imported_note.source: Shortcuts imported — review below, then Save.
shortcuts.imported_note.translation: Shortcuts imported — review below, then 保存.

shortcuts.inactive.caption.source: These shortcuts target spaces that are not in the current space list. They still work — pressing one recreates its space — and they keep their key combo. Rebind or remove them here; they become active again when their space returns.
shortcuts.inactive.caption.translation: These shortcuts target spaces that are not in the current space list. They still work — pressing one recreates its space — and they keep their key combo. Rebind or remove them here; they become active again when their space returns.（ZH）

shortcuts.modes.caption.source: Modes are alternate shortcut sets — only the active mode's shortcuts fire. Bind a key below to switch between them. “default” is the standard mode and is always the active one after the app starts.
shortcuts.modes.caption.translation: 模式s are alternate shortcut sets — only the active mode's shortcuts fire. Bind a key below to switch between them. “default” is the standard mode and is always the active one after the app starts.

shortcuts.move_to_track.caption.source: Only relevant if you're using the track layout.
shortcuts.move_to_track.caption.translation: Only relevant if you're using the track layout.（ZH）

shortcuts.override.caption.source: Dimmed rows are inherited from the base shortcuts and stay in sync with them. Edit a row to override it for this profile only; matching the base again makes it inherited again. Removing an inherited row only resets it — to disable a combo in this profile, rebind it to a no-op action instead.
shortcuts.override.caption.translation: Dimmed rows are inherited from the base shortcuts and stay in sync with them. 编辑 a row to override it for this profile only; matching the base again makes it inherited again. Removing an inherited row only resets it — to disable a combo in this profile, rebind it to a no-op action instead.

shortcuts.override.staged.source: Editing “%1$@” — shortcuts take effect the next time this profile is active.
shortcuts.override.staged.translation: 编辑ing “%1$@” — shortcuts take effect the next time this profile is active.

shortcuts.override.staged_loaded.source: Editing “%1$@” — shortcuts re-apply as soon as you save.
shortcuts.override.staged_loaded.translation: 编辑ing “%1$@” — shortcuts re-apply as soon as you save.

shortcuts.panel.dismiss_hint.source: Esc or click away to close
shortcuts.panel.dismiss_hint.translation: Esc or click away to close（ZH）

shortcuts.panel.unavailable.source: Shortcuts are managed by your init.lua.
shortcuts.panel.unavailable.translation: Shortcuts are managed by your init.lua.（ZH）

shortcuts.size_float.feedback.source: Alert sound when resize can't apply
shortcuts.size_float.feedback.translation: Alert sound when resize can't apply（ZH）

shortcuts.size_float.layouts_caption.source: Grow/Shrink only applies in the bsp, stack, scrolling, and track layouts; it is a no-op in monocle, grid, and floating. Width and height resize independently; scrolling resizes its slot along the scroll axis for both, and in track one axis resizes the window's track, the other its share within it.
shortcuts.size_float.layouts_caption.translation: Grow/Shrink only applies in the bsp, stack, scrolling, and track layouts; it is a no-op in monocle, grid, and floating. Width and height resize independently; scrolling resizes its slot along the scroll axis for both, and in track one axis resizes the window's track, the other its share within it.（ZH）

space_bar.alignment.label.help.source: Where the Space items — and the front-app segment, when shown — sit along the bar. Start and End follow the edge — a left bar's Start is its top.
space_bar.alignment.label.help.translation: 空间项目沿栏放置的位置。

space_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.source: Boxed draws a box per item, not a shared plate, so there is nothing to size.
space_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.translation: 框状会在每个项目周围绘制方框。

space_bar.color.active_space.help.source: Tints the active space's identifier and its app glyphs.
space_bar.color.active_space.help.translation: 活动空间标识符及图标颜色。

space_bar.color.focused_item.help.source: Tints the focused window — its glyph in the active Space and the front-app segment. Glyph tint needs Glyphs icon mode.

space_bar.color.group_badge.help.source: Count and overflow badges on the active space; inactive spaces mute them from the item color. Grouping is always on.

space_bar.copy_appearance.translation: 复制 App Bar 外观…

space_bar.copy_appearance.caption.source: Copies the App Bar's current sizes, style, and colors — a one-time starting point, not a live link.
space_bar.copy_appearance.caption.translation: 复制 App Bar 的当前尺寸、样式和颜色。

space_bar.copy_appearance.help.source: Takes the App Bar's current sizes, style, and colors once; edits afterwards stay independent.
space_bar.copy_appearance.help.translation: 一次性获取 App Bar 设置。

space_bar.disabled.help.source: Turn on Show Space Bar to edit these settings.
space_bar.disabled.help.translation: 启用 Space Bar 以修改这些设置。

space_bar.edge.label.help.source: Which screen edge the Space Bar occupies. Sharing an edge with the App Bar is fine — the two stack.
space_bar.edge.label.help.translation: Space Bar 依附的屏幕边缘。

space_bar.enabled.help.source: One bar per display listing that display's Spaces — click a Space to switch to it. The bar reserves its edge in every layout.
space_bar.enabled.help.translation: 按显示器显示空间列表栏。

space_bar.global_style.caption.source: One bar per display, every layout. All settings are global.
space_bar.global_style.caption.translation: 每个显示器一个栏，适用于所有布局。设置均为全局。

space_bar.glyph_cap.help.source: How many app glyphs a Space shows before the rest collapse into a +n badge. Adjacent windows of the same app count as one glyph.
space_bar.glyph_cap.help.translation: 折叠为 +n 徽标前显示的图标数量。

space_bar.glyph_cap.summary.source: Up to %1$d app groups per Space; more collapse into a +n badge.
space_bar.glyph_cap.summary.translation: 每个空间最多显示 %1$d 个应用组。

space_bar.hide_empty.help.source: Spaces with no windows are hidden from the bar, except the Space you're currently on. Use a shortcut to jump to a hidden Space.
space_bar.hide_empty.help.translation: 从栏中隐藏无窗口的空间。

space_bar.icon_source.help.source: How app glyphs are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol colored by the bar's item colors; apps without a symbol keep their app icon.
space_bar.icon_source.help.translation: 选择应用图标的绘制方式。

space_bar.preview.ax.translation: Space Bar 预览：位置 %1$@，样式 %2$@。

space_bar.show_front_app.help.source: Adds a trailing segment with the focused window of the Space each display currently shows. Icon-only on vertical bars.
space_bar.show_front_app.help.translation: 添加指示当前聚焦窗口的段落。

space_bar.spring_delay.help.source: Drag a window onto a Space and hold this long for the view to spring to that Space, so you can drop the window into its layout. A quicker drop moves the window there without switching.
space_bar.spring_delay.help.translation: 拖动窗口悬停切换空间所需的延迟时间。

space_override.caption.translation: 未勾选的设置继承 %1$@ 的默认值。

space_override.floating.none.translation: Floating 没有按空间划分的覆盖。

space_override.reset_all_confirm.message.source: This clears every layout's saved overrides for this space, not just the current one. This can't be undone.
space_override.reset_all_confirm.message.translation: 这将清除该空间针对每个布局保存的覆盖。此操作无法撤销。

space_override.slot_size.help.source: Sets each scrolling window's size along the scroll direction. Horizontal uses column width; vertical uses row height. Default is 1100 pt horizontally and 80% of the available height vertically.
space_override.slot_size.help.translation: 设置每个滚动窗口沿滚动方向的尺寸。

spaces.caption.source: Each space has its own layout. Add spaces here; they appear in the shortcut and app-rule lists too. Drag rows to reorder.
spaces.caption.translation: 每个空间都有自己的布局。拖动行可重新排序。

spaces.delete_confirm.message.source: This space has customized settings — its layout overrides, monitor pin, and any Main or Fallback role are removed too. You can add the space back, but not its settings.
spaces.delete_confirm.message.translation: 此空间拥有自定义设置，删除后设置将丢失。

spaces.empty.source: No spaces yet — add one below. Until you do, every window tiles in a single default space.
spaces.empty.translation: 暂无空间，请在下方添加。

spaces.fallback_badge.help.source: Windows from a removed space land here when you switch profiles.
spaces.fallback_badge.help.translation: 切换配置文件时被删除空间的窗口将放置在此处。

spaces.fallback_caption.source: When you switch profiles, windows from a space the new profile doesn't have land in its fallback space (the first space when none is chosen).
spaces.fallback_caption.translation: 切换配置文件时，不存在的空间窗口将落在回退空间。

spaces.overrides.a11y.translation: %1$@ 的布局覆盖（已保存 %2$d 项）

sticky.caption.source: Sticky windows stay visible on every space (Toggle sticky, in Shortcuts).
sticky.caption.translation: 标记为 Sticky 的 Floating 窗口将在所有空间保持可见。

sticky.display.pill.source: Can only be moved to a different display
sticky.display.pill.translation: 仅可移动至其他显示器

sticky.everywhere.pill.source: Sticky windows can't be moved to another space
sticky.everywhere.pill.translation: Sticky 窗口无法移动至其他空间

sticky.home.pill.source: Can only be moved in its home space %1$@
sticky.home.pill.translation: 仅可在其主空间 %1$@ 内移动

sticky.mark.translation: 在 Sticky 窗口上显示标记

sticky.mark.forced.source: On — the Space Bar is off, so this is the only sticky mark.
sticky.mark.forced.translation: 开启 — Space Bar 已关闭，因此这是唯一的 Sticky 标记。

sticky.mark.help.source: A sticky window can look identical to a normal one, so KiwiDesk draws a small mark in its top-right corner. The Space Bar shows its own sticky badge either way.
sticky.mark.help.translation: 在 Sticky 窗口右上角绘制一个小标记。

sticky.pile.pill.source: Sticky windows can't be moved to the pile
sticky.pile.pill.translation: Sticky 窗口无法移动至堆栈

system_shortcut.mission_control_space_le.translation: 调度中心：左移一个屏幕/空间

system_shortcut.mission_control_space_ri.translation: 调度中心：右移一个屏幕/空间

track.auto_tracks.gates.source: Auto track limit is on for this space, so the screen decides how many open.
track.auto_tracks.gates.translation: 自动轨道上限已开启，屏幕尺寸决定打开的轨道数。

track.auto_tracks_caption.source: Fits as many tracks as the screen allows, using the minimum window size above — opening and collapsing them as windows come and go.
track.auto_tracks_caption.translation: 根据最小窗口尺寸自动适应屏幕所允许的最大轨道数。

track.limit_caption.source: Bounded by the minimum window size above: more tracks than fit collapse into the overflow track.
track.limit_caption.translation: 超出容纳限制的轨道将折叠至溢出轨道。

track.new_window_position.help.source: With “Opens its own track”, where the new track lands among the tracks; with “Fills the focused track”, where the window lands inside it: First, Last, or right before or after the focused one.
track.new_window_position.help.translation: 指定新轨道或新窗口的插入位置。
